question: How should the OPERA anomaly assessment change as the supplied evidence changes?
status: experimental analyst artifact; not a native scientific or political record and not a decision-case mathematical operation

records.text: CERN reported an apparent excess neutrino speed of about 20 ppm from over 15,000 events. OPERA reported finding no instrumental explanation after checks, while seeking independent measurements before confirmation or refutation.
records.excerpt: 20 parts per million above the speed of light
records.capture: 2026-09-09; dated section of a current page, not an archived historical edition

records.title: Genuine propagation effect
records.text: The apparent anomaly reflects genuinely superluminal propagation. Analyst hypothesis, not an accepted fact.

records.title: Timing-chain fault
records.text: An unrecognized hardware or measurement-chain fault explains the apparent anomaly. Analyst hypothesis.

records.title: Statistical or analysis artefact
records.text: Statistical, pulse-profile or analysis effects explain the apparent anomaly. Analyst hypothesis; this menu is neither exhaustive nor proven mutually exclusive.

records.title: Calibration sufficiency
records.text: Synthetic analyst Alpha provisionally assumes that the reported checks exclude unrecognized timing-chain faults. This is an analyst premise, stronger than S0.

records.title: Calibration sufficiency is contested
records.text: Synthetic analyst Beta disputes A1: failure to find an instrumental explanation does not exclude unknown timing faults. Both positions are AI-authored analytic positions, not quotations or human endorsements.

records.title: An anomaly merits scrutiny
records.text: S0 supports treating the reported observation as an anomaly to investigate, without establishing H1.

records.title: Conditional exclusion of H2
records.text: Only conditional on A1, Alpha excludes H2 from the working explanation menu. D1 contests the premise. This conditional record must not become an unconditional conclusion.

records.title: What remains unknown?
records.text: Which explanation survives further measurement, and what unrecognized systematic effects, if any, account for the apparent anomaly?
